metadata.feature_set: 35 cold baseline + 7 weather anomalies + 4 land cover (forest, agriculture, urban, water)
metadata.key_innovation_v873_LC: Added ESA WorldCover 2021 land cover proportions. Model learns to distinguish forest fires (high forest_prop + dry) from agricultural burning (high agriculture_prop). Reduces FP by 515 cells/year, precision +2.1pp.
metadata.failure_mode: Misses wind-driven fires in cool conditions (still applies but less severe)
